AGO.note: Document states nothing on authentication services.
Document states no link between civil register and ID system as a record flow; it only says AGT updates its cadastre from civil ID data, which is a tax matter.
Counts collective taxpayers in the AGT cadastre only; no business register stated.
Document states nothing on the voters' roll.
Gives taxpayer counts, not national ID enrolment.
Document states nothing on an ID number at birth.
Document states nothing on who operates or owns the ID system.

facts.fact: Expansao reports that since October 2018 the national ID (BI) number has been the taxpayer number (NIF) held in the AGT taxpayer register, and AGT updates its cadastre daily from civil ID records.

AGO.note: Document states nothing on biometrics, certification or system issuance.
Document states nothing on a social registry.

facts.fact: AGT's taxpayer cadastre held 11,173,618 registered taxpayers in January 2024 (10,849,787 individuals, 323,831 collective), according to AGT data cited by Expansao.
Expansao reports the taxpayer number (NIF) has been the national ID (BI) number since October 2018, and AGT mass-registers individuals ex officio from civil ID records.
